surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Caller-supplied `executable` string and `arguments` vector.
TRUST: Trust only the single fixed executable `/usr/bin/printf`; reject every other executable value as untrusted.
SINK: External program invocation that executes the selected utility with supplied arguments and captures standard output.
GUARD: Enforce exact-match allowlist against `/usr/bin/printf`, raising `ValueError` on mismatch; pass arguments as a direct vector; keep command-interpreter or shell processing disabled.
ORDER: Validate executable against the fixed allowlist before subprocess creation; invoke with vector arguments and disabled shell.
EFFECT: Return captured standard output as text; raise `ValueError` for disallowed executables; let process failures propagate unchanged.
END_PLAN
